verdict.rationale: 1Password documents exporting your information from its apps to move to a different app, and it stores one-time passwords. The CLI and SDKs offer programmatic item access as a scripted alternative. The evidence does not say whether exports include TOTP seeds, or which format they use. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that TOTP secrets are included in exports, documentation of an open readable export format (e.g. CSV/otpauth URIs), independent hands-on corroboration of a clean migration to another authenticator.
